bio.text: Jason Perillo, a Republican, has represented District 21 in the Connecticut State Senate since February 28, 2025, and is on the November 2026 ballot for re-election.
He previously served in the Connecticut House of Representatives for District 113 from 2007 to 2025.
He earned a bachelor's degree from Georgetown University and graduate degrees from Boston College and Harvard University, and his career includes work in healthcare administration.
